en: The image shows a vintage postcard featuring an ornate fountain with classical statues and multiple streams of water. The fountain is set in a lush park with green trees and shrubbery. Several figures, including children and an adult, are present around the fountain. The overall coloring and style suggest an early 20th-century aesthetic. At the top, there is printed text: 'GRAZ. Stadtpark Brunnen.'
